verdict.rationale: Turso lets users provision and tear down databases via its API/CLI (turso-docs-8, turso-docs-12) and control encryption/data residency (turso-docs-27, turso-docs-28), giving some control over data lifecycle, but there is no explicit documentation of retention policies, automated data expiry/TTL, or compliance-oriented deletion guarantees (e.g., GDPR 'right to be forgotten') beyond ad-hoc DB deletion. missing for 10: explicit retention-policy docs, automated data-expiry/TTL controls, compliance certifications for deletion guarantees.
